programs.name: Computer Science
programs.notes: UBC admission is broad-based: grades plus the Personal Profile. Entry is through the Faculty of Science. BC equivalents of the listed courses are English Studies 12, Pre-Calculus 12, and a Grade 12 science.

supplementary.name: Personal Profile
supplementary.description: Short written responses about experiences, activities, and what you learned from them; weighted alongside grades for all direct-entry UBC applicants.

tips.title: Take the Personal Profile seriously
tips.detail: The Personal Profile is weighted alongside your marks. Draft your short answers early, be specific about what you did and what it taught you, and have someone you trust review them before submitting.

tips.title: UBC application deadline
tips.detail: Apply through EducationPlannerBC by January 15, 2027 for September 2027 entry. Verify the current cycle's dates on UBC's admissions site before relying on them.

tips.title: Major entrance awards are profile-based
tips.detail: UBC's major entrance awards, including Presidential Scholars Awards, are selected from the application and Personal Profile rather than an automatic average cutoff; some require a separate application.

tips.title: Apply early through EducationPlannerBC
tips.detail: UNBC deadlines vary by program and intake and are later than the big research universities, but applying in the winter keeps scholarship and housing options open. Verify the current cycle's dates on unbc.ca.

tips.detail: Engineering seats at UNBC are limited; apply in the winter for September entry and verify the current cycle's dates on unbc.ca.

programs.name: Commerce
programs.notes: Majors include accounting, finance, marketing, and human resources. UNBC admission is requirements-based and less average-competitive than the large research universities. A BC Grade 12 math (Pre-Calculus 12 or Foundations of Math 12) satisfies the math requirement.

tips.title: Apply early through EducationPlannerBC

programs.name: Nursing (Northern Collaborative BScN)
programs.notes: Delivered through the Northern Collaborative Baccalaureate Nursing Program with partner colleges in northern BC. Seats are limited and selection is more competitive than UNBC's general admission. In BC terms, expect English Studies 12, Anatomy and Physiology 12 (or Biology 12), a Grade 12 math, and at least Chemistry 11.

tips.title: Nursing intakes close early
tips.detail: Nursing seats are capped and applications often close months before the semester begins. Apply through EducationPlannerBC as early as the cycle opens and verify the current dates on unbc.ca.
